title: Authors by number of books
statementMd:
Show each author who has books and how many they wrote, most first (ties by name).

Expected columns: `name`, `books`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT a.name, COUNT(*) AS books FROM authors a JOIN books b ON b.author_id = a.id GROUP BY a.id, a.name ORDER BY books DESC, a.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
